newsitem.title: SPAIN: RALLYING-LIATTI AND MCRAE BATTLE FOR CATALUNYA TITLE.
newsitem.headline: RALLYING-LIATTI AND MCRAE BATTLE FOR CATALUNYA TITLE.

text.p: Spain's Catalunya Rally, last round of the World Rally Championship, has become a tense duel between Subaru team mates Piero Liatti of Italy and Britain's Colin McRae.
McRae, World Champion in 1995, stepped up the pressure in the afternoon of the second day to move from fourth to second and slice Liatti's lead to just three seconds.

"If we win the rally, we finish second in the championship. If we come second, we don't," said McRae, who is anxious to assert his number one position in the team but fears he could be ordered not to challenge his team mate.
Subaru need to finish strongly to retain the world manufacturers championship.
Rising Toyota driver Freddie Loix inched into third place ahead of fellow Belgian and early leader Bruno Thiry who has been slowed by tyre trouble in his Ford.
Loix will be on more familiar ground during the third and final leg, but said he doubted he could catch the Subarus.

Although tyre problems have hampered world champion Tommi Makinen, the Finnish Mitsubishi driver is well placed in fifth to make up ground as the first four jostle for positions in the closing kilometres.
French Champion Patrick Bernardini dropped back to sixth when his Ford hit brake problems in the afternoon.
The 1,368 km rally finishes in Lloret de Mar on Wednesday.
